title: Huk Nacionpa Nombrasqa Umalliqnin
intro: Huk llaqtapaq hatun sasachakuy hinaspa hukmanyasqa tiempopim, Diospa nombramienton ruwakurqa. Kay sapan runaqa, qallariypiqa askha runakunaq mana qhawarisqanmi, Allahpa akllasqan karqan, huk nacionta umallinanpaq, manchay awqa contra. Willakuyninkuqa testamenton iñiypa atiyninta, hinallataq hanaq pacha kamachikuypa qhepanpi yachayniyoq kayninta, rikuchispa cheqaq umalliq kayqa manan sapa kutichu tarikun suyasqa cheqaskunapi.
clues: Allahpa akllasqanmi karqani llaqtaypaq umalliq kanaypaq, paykunan huk kamachikuqta maskharqanku Paypa ruwayninpi maqanakunankupaq.
Runayqa qallariypiqa tapuwarqankun nombrasqa kasqayta, hukkuna aswan merecesqankuta yuyaykuspanku qhapaq kasqankurayku otaq mirayninkurayku.
Allin umalliq kasqaymanta huk señalmi karqan huk sagrado caja kutimusqan, chaypin kasharqan ñawpaq profetakunaq reliquiakuna, chaymi thak kayta apamurqan.
Ejercitoytan pusarqani huk mayuman, chaypin pruebarqani kasukusqankuta, huk cucharallamanta aswan unuta ukyananta hark’aspa.
Prueba tukukuptinpas pisillaña mana kuyurispalla karqaku chaypas, huk kallpasapa maqanakuqwan ejercitonwan tuparqayku.
Kamachisqaywanmi ejercitoymanta huk wayna, mana reqsisqa maqanakuq, mana manchakuspa awqaq manchakuypaq atipaqninwan atipanakurqan, atiparqan ima.

trial.label: Prueba/Evento nisqa
options: Huk hatunkaray runapa contranpi umalliq hina churasqa kasqan
trial.answer: Huk hatunkaray runapa contranpi umalliq hina churasqa kasqan

outcome.label: Tukusqa
options: Huk qhapaq suyun sayarichisqa karqan, hatun qhapaq atiyniyoq, atiyniyoq ima.
Awqaq atipaqninmi atipasqa karqan, Allahtaq atipayta qorqan.
Ancha ch’akiymi chay hallp’ata askha watakuna ñak’arichirqan.
outcome.answer: Awqaq atipaqninmi atipasqa karqan, Allahtaq atipayta qorqan.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
